_doc: Task 55: character creation points (written by the reviewer; the builder wires the code). The player picks one background, buys starting skill levels, and takes perks (cost points) and flaws (give points). The points left must be 0 or more to start. budget = budget.base + budget.difficulty[diff] + background.points. Skill levels cost skill_costs[level-1] each, up to skill_cap at creation; a background's starting levels are free. Each perk / flaw has: label, text (the one plain line shown on its card), cost (perks, positive) or points (flaws, positive = points given), effects (keys the code applies through the real systems; see effect_keys), and optional excludes (ids that cannot be taken with it) and requires. Personality traits stay free and separate (traits.json). Heirs who take over on death skip this page: their skills, flaws and record come from their life. Backgrounds never depend on heritage or community.

effect_keys.skill_xp_mult: multiplier on all skill XP gained
effect_keys.check: flat bonus (+) or malus (-) on SkillCheck for the listed skills, in skill levels
effect_keys.carry_mult: multiplier on what the person can carry
effect_keys.wake_on_noise: multiplier on the chance a night noise wakes them (intruders, alarms, fire)
effect_keys.food_sickness_mult: multiplier on getting sick from food
effect_keys.willpower: bonus (+) or malus (-) used in rehab, resisting threats and manipulation, staying calm (fire, fights, questioning)
effect_keys.first_impression: bonus (+) or malus (-) on how strangers and police first react
effect_keys.witness_id_mult: multiplier on how easily witnesses identify the person
effect_keys.fight_start_mult: multiplier on arguments turning into fights
effect_keys.sleep_quality: bonus (+) or malus (-) on how well sleep restores energy
effect_keys.addiction_mult: multiplier on the existing addiction odds
effect_keys.smoke_dose_mult: multiplier on smoke inhaled in a fire
effect_keys.chase_mult: multiplier on fitness in chases and running
effect_keys.fear: a fear trigger id (dogs, heights): the person refuses or panics near it
effect_keys.item: an item they start with (bike, glasses, phone is standard)
effect_keys.debt: a real debt to a real lender: {amount, lender, repay_per_week}
effect_keys.credit: bank credit standing used for loans: good / bad
effect_keys.record: a criminal record in the justice system: {charges: [...], years_ago}
effect_keys.habit: a daily habit with a real cost and need: {need, item, cost_per_day}
effect_keys.hiring: bonus (+) or malus (-) on being hired, by job kind
effect_keys.fixed: requires an item to remove the malus (e.g. glasses)

nobody.label: Nobody special
nobody.text: No experience to speak of. More points to spend.

street_kid.label: Street kid
street_kid.text: Grew up rough. Knows how to keep out of sight and stand their ground.

trade_apprentice.label: Trade apprentice
trade_apprentice.text: Spent a couple of years learning a trade.

college_dropout.label: College dropout
college_dropout.text: A year of classes and a loan to show for it.

retail_worker.label: Retail worker
retail_worker.text: Years behind a till. Good with people, hard to fool.

delivery_driver.label: Delivery driver
delivery_driver.text: Knows the roads and is used to being on their feet.

care_worker.label: Care worker
care_worker.text: Looked after people for a living.

kitchen_hand.label: Kitchen hand
kitchen_hand.text: Worked the back of a busy kitchen.

ex_con.label: Fresh out
ex_con.text: Just finished a sentence. Learned things inside, and the record follows you.

strong.label: Strong
strong.text: Stronger than most. Fights better and carries more.

tough.label: Tough
tough.text: Shrugs off knocks and heals fast.

strong_willed.label: Strong-willed
strong_willed.text: Hard to push around, hard to tempt.

owns_bike.label: Owns a bike
owns_bike.text: Gets around town faster than on foot.

clean_cut.label: Clean-cut
clean_cut.text: Looks trustworthy to people who don't know them.

slow_learner.label: Slow learner
slow_learner.text: Takes longer to get the hang of things.

weak_stomach.label: Weak stomach
weak_stomach.text: Gets sick from food more often.

asthma.label: Asthma
asthma.text: Short of breath when running or in smoke.

smoker.label: Smoker
smoker.text: Needs cigarettes every day, and they cost money.

in_debt.label: In debt
in_debt.text: Owes money, and the lender wants it back.

record.label: Criminal record
record.text: An old conviction that shows up on checks.

memorable_face.label: Memorable face
memorable_face.text: A scar or tattoo people remember.
